text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kyoto Racecourse is enveloped in cheers 
for the Mejiro family. A testament to 
those who have walked alongside the voices 
of high expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... what does it mean to "face your 
fans"? Ines Fujin tried to learn the 
resolve and strength needed to respond to 
them from the two members of the Mejiro 
family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan and Mejiro McQueen. Ines Fujin 
challenges the Tenno Sho (Spring), where 
these two powerhouses lie in wait!
